description: Ireland: tax and benefit limits that have not changed for years (CGT annual exemption since 1992, severance basic exemption since 1998 and its EUR10,000 increase since 2002, small gift exemption since 2003, medical card limit and statutory redundancy pay cap since 2005, welfare means test savings disregard since 2005, CGT retirement relief limit since 2007, Fair Deal asset disregard since 2009, income tax exemption at 65, tax-free pension lump sum and termination payment cap since 2011, health insurance relief cap since 2013, USC exemption and Home Carer Tax Credit income limit since 2016, HAP rent limits since 2017), each with the amount, the year it was last set and the value at 2025 prices on the CSO Consumer Price Index. Optional id filters to one limit. Use this when someone asks which Irish thresholds are frozen or what one would be today.
